name: Old English Gin
distillery: Langley Distillery (bottled at Thames Distillery, London)
production: Distilled at Langley in a John Dore copper pot still called 'Angela'
Cardamom distillate made separately by Henrik Hammer and blended
About 4 g/L sugar added before bottling
Bottled in washed, reused champagne bottles with cork and wax seal
history: 1783 | Recipe date, from old recipes kept at Langley
nose: Liquorice, cassia, earthy orris, faint citrus
notes: Slightly sweetened Old Tom-style distilled gin. Cardamom as 11th botanical is implied by Difford's (bottle graphic). Henrik Hammer is also known for Geranium Gin.
